hero.title: Bhupal Nobles' University
hero.summary: Bhupal Nobles' University offers undergraduate agriculture in Udaipur. Its official course table describes a four-year degree with Hindi and English as teaching media. The audited ICAR record identifies B.N. College of Agriculture as the accredited unit within the university.

overview.heading: An Udaipur university with a named agricultural college
paragraphs: Bhupal Nobles' University identifies its establishing legislation as Rajasthan Act No. 23 of 2015 and names Vidya Pracharini Sabha, Bhupal Nobles' Sansthan as its promoter. Its agriculture course listing provides a faculty contact and a defined undergraduate route rather than a broad catalogue of unrelated professional courses.

The course table lists a four-year agriculture degree for students from science or agriculture at 10+2 level. It identifies Hindi and English as media of instruction. The university’s general admission guidelines emphasise completion of the application and final university approval. Those general rules should be read alongside a current agriculture admission notice, which was not verified in this research.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: Bhupal Nobles’ official registration page identifies the 2026-27 first-year/first-semester admission form. Linked common instructions describe account creation, document upload and an online INR500 form payment. The instructions are undated; confirm the agriculture offer and payable application charge before paying.

steps.title: Obtain the information bulletin
steps.text: The university instructs applicants to read the bulletin before filling the form.

steps.title: Complete the application carefully
steps.text: The guidelines state that incomplete forms will not be accepted and final admission requires university approval.

documents: Class X and XII mark sheets, photograph and signature for upload under the common form instructions.
A valid email address and mobile number for registration/login.

campus.heading: Agriculture within the Udaipur campus
campus.intro: The checked university pages establish the agriculture faculty and Udaipur contact location. They did not provide a sufficiently detailed, dated inventory of agricultural farms or laboratories to reproduce here.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: An agriculture-specific scholarship and its current conditions have not yet been verified for this profile.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: Bhupal Nobles' University publishes an Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission for NIRF 2026. Its programme-duration cohorts report the graduating group, students placed, students entering higher studies and the median salary of placed graduates. These historical institutional submissions are not a placement promise or a salary estimate for every student or individual specialisation.

statistics.value: 54 graduates in minimum stipulated time; 12 placed; 15 selected for higher studies; median annual salary of placed graduates INR 3,00,000.

faqs.question: Which unit appears in Bhupal Nobles' ICAR entry?
faqs.answer: The audited register names B.N. College of Agriculture and lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faqs.question: What is the published course duration?
faqs.answer: The university’s agriculture table gives four years.

faqs.question: Which teaching languages are listed?
faqs.answer: The official table identifies Hindi and English. Confirm how individual classes and examinations are delivered.

faqs.question: What school qualification is shown?
faqs.answer: The undated course table lists 10+2 Science or Agriculture with 45%. An intake-specific rule is still needed.

faqs.question: Does submitting a form make admission final?
faqs.answer: The university guidelines state that finalisation requires its approval.
